```yaml
name: Auto merge release into main

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * *' # 4am CST
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.repository == 'jdx/mise'
    env:
      GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: mise-en-dev
      GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: mise-en-dev@example.com
      GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: mise-en-dev
      GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: mise-en-dev@example.com
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: main

      - name: Configure git
        run: |
          git config user.name "$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME"
          git config user.email "$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"

      - name: Find open release→main PR
        id: find_pr
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr list --head release --base main --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Exit if no PR
        if: steps.find_pr.outputs.pr_number == ''
        run: |
          echo "No open release→main PR found. Exiting."
          exit 0

      - name: Merge PR
        run: |
          if ! gh pr merge ${{ steps.find_pr.outputs.pr_number }} --merge --auto --delete-branch; then
            echo "Merge failed (conflicts or failing checks). Skipping."
            exit 0
          fi
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
```

yaml:
name: Auto merge release into main

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * *' # 4am CST
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.repository == 'jdx/mise'
    env:
      GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: mise-en-dev
      GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: mise-en-dev@example.com
      GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: mise-en-dev
      GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: mise-en-dev@example.com
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: main

      - name: Configure git
        run: |
          git config user.name "$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME"
          git config user.email "$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"

      - name: Find open release→main PR
        id: find_pr
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr list --head release --base main --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Exit if no PR
        if: steps.find_pr.outputs.pr_number == ''
        run: |
          echo "No open release→main PR found. Exiting."
          exit 0

      - name: Merge PR
        run: |
          if ! gh pr merge ${{ steps.find_pr.outputs.pr_number }} --merge --auto --delete-branch; then
            echo "Merge failed (conflicts or failing checks). Skipping."
            exit 0
          fi
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
